items.text: Hi Climbers,
We are releasing an update to On the Trail DLC with a series of tweaks so you can customize the difficulty of your climb alongside a global pass of the difficulty settings.
We’ve also reviewed and updated the routes in the Lamu gym.
As in the main game, you can now choose between Explorer, Alpinist and Free solo difficulty settings for the DLC content.

The energy system received a balancing pass: climbers get tired less quickly and the energy goes down slower. It should feel less punitive, especially when holding on smooth surfaces. The Explorer difficulty offers an even lighter challenge for those who wish to climb and explore with less constraints.
Some routes in Lamu gym were tweaked to be a bit more forgiving
We have fixed several bugs, including soft locks that had been reported.

releases.displayName: An update about On the Trail's release date

items.text: Hi Climbers,

We're adding features to Cairn's Free DLC On the Trail. The new climbing spots are packed with challenges and surprises, but being much smaller mountains than Kami, we've tweaked the formula to keep the tension in every climb.

This means we need a bit more time, and On the Trail won't be ready for August 13th. It's still coming soon, and we will share the release date as soon as we have it. We appreciate your patience climbers, see you on the trail!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050904/9f155f2f46c793780ba86f978544e93bdbcc4990.jpg"]

releases.displayName: Cairn update - Wear your very own ascent!

items.text: Hi climbers,
Have you reached the summit yet?

You can now immortalize your very own Kami ascent on a T-shirt! Simply finish the game, head to the Extra menu and customize your Cairn T-shirt. Perfect to show off your unique route to the peak during your digital and physical climbing sessions!
Update the game to access the shirt creation menu in Extra.
And find out more here: https://merch.thegamebakers.com/products/your-ascent-tee
The update to version 1.1.393 also includes minor improvements for our Speedrunning friends and some bug fixes.
Hello climbers,

It’s time for a Quality of Life update for Cairn! It includes a bunch of adjustments, new features and bug fixes that will make your experience with Cairn even smoother. In particular we are bringing tweaks to accessibility, features you asked for like the automatic finger tapping, a new feature to visualise Aava’s efforts, improvements to Aava’s getting down from walls, Climbot’s behaviour and much more. Read below for more details.
Ticking the No survival option will refill your survival gauges, helping you get out of a difficult situation
When you’re in difficulty, you now have more chances to find useful loot for your survival
You can now automatically tape your fingers
The breathing feedback option lets you visualise Aava’s efforts. We’re hoping this feature can help climbers with hearing disabilities, let us know if it does and how we can improve!
Photo mode additional options: remove Aava’s hood, change damage level, add logo… We’re ready to see your new pictures!

We have also improved some behaviours - in particular regarding Aava getting down from a wall without falling. and Climbot’s general behaviour so he gets less close to you especially in Free Solo mode.
We have also fixed a significant quantity of bugs!

Hello climbers,

[p align="start"]Thank you for the overwhelmingly positive feedback on the game - and thank you for the bug reports too! Our team is monitoring your reports, and we have pulled together a new patch with the following fixes:
Fixed a corrupted save

If you are in this rare situation please head to Steam / Cairn / Settings / Installed files and click Verify the integrity of game files. This will check all the files and reinstall any missing file and should solve the issue.

Hello climbers,
We're so excited to see so many of you enjoy Cairn.
Our team has been monitoring the forums, social media and our inboxes to gather your feedback and bug reports, and we have pulled together a patch.
We have found a temporary solution for the FPS issues on AMD RX 9000 series cards, Steam Deck, and ROG Ally X. Here is how to improve your framerate if you're in this situation.
In Steam / Cairn / Game Settings / General / Launch Options (See screen below) :
On Windows add this launch option -force-d3d12
On Linux add this launch option -force-vulkan
On Steam Deck add this launch option -force-vulkan
We will keep working on performance improvements, but until then, this quick setting change should greatly improve your experience!
We have also put together a patch that solves some minor bugs:
Limb selection panel tutorial screen stays on screen if a fall during the tutorial
Phone call message remains on screen, only experienced by Turkish players

With a lot of love,
The Bakers

releases.displayName: The Cairn demo update is here - and you can win some merch!

items.text: Hi climbers,
It’s time! Ghostly apparitions are now available in Cairn’s demo. They’re not all that scary though, we think.
You can climb Tenzen alongside selected community, dev and content creators ghosts, and see what everyone’s been getting up to. Maybe you can try something new?
We’re bringing the routes contest back! We're excited to see what you can come up with. Here are the categories :
Most unexpected route - can you find one no ghost is taking?
Most difficult free solo route - no pitons!
Funniest route - get creative
To enter, send us a screenshot of the route recap screen at fanart@thegamebakers.com before October 20th, 2025, at 6pm CEST (9am pst)
The winners will receive some of the exclusive Cairn merch, like these postcards of the posters in the demo! [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050904/3ab0b7d7749cedaf8eb4325f327d54cd55082290.jpg"]
A special thank you to Alex Baena, Mugthief, and Ravs for joining the ghosts ✨
Hi climbers,
We’re bringing another update to the demo, and it’s for a limited time only!

Starting on October 13, you’ll be able to see selected ghosts climbing Mount Tenzen with you. You can race them, learn how they tackle some particularly difficult routes, or sit back and watch the chaos unfold.
We’ve been truly touched by the reception of Cairn’s demo, and we wanted to celebrate the incredible community that has formed around it. We hope you enjoy the update as much as we did making it !

releases.displayName: Cairn now Q1 2026 and Demo Ghost Update

items.text: Hi Climbers,

Today we're bringing both good, and not so good news, but there's still some good in it. We've decided to delay the launch of Cairn on PC and PS5 to Q1 2026 so we can spend a bit more time on debug and optimisation.
To bridge the gap we're bringing an update to Cairn's demo on October 13, with ghosts of other players in the demo!
[p align="justify"]

[p align="justify"]The team has made the tough decision to delay Cairn to ensure that it launches at its best. Our goal has always been to create games you remember long after playing them, and for Cairn, despite our best efforts, this requires a little more time.
[p align="justify"]

[p align="justify"]We’ve been running a lot of playtests, and you’ve let us know that we have something truly special with Cairn. Still, we also see the improvements we can still make to give you the best game we can. After five years of work, so close to our goal, we don't want to rush it.
With the game content complete, we’re going to use the extra few weeks to focus on optimization, debug, and polish. “It’s not on the mountains we trip, but on the small pebbles".
The mountain is in sight.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050904/6d879f42bc3290b847ba3f5bee860baa33c3730e.jpg"]
In really exciting news though, we’ve been working with the community on a special demo update!

For a limited time, you’ll see ghosts of other players climbing alongside you on Mount Tenzen - speedrunners, community members and the dev team. You’ll be able to race the best, learn new techniques or discover new routes and hidden areas. Here's a sneak peek:

items.text: Hi everyone,
We're back with a demo update, and improvements a lot of you have been requesting!

Most of the time, it's good to rely on the game's calculations to select the best limb to move next. It's smooth and efficient. But there's always this one time where you want total control. We heard you. So we are introducing New manual limb selection modes! Not one, not two, but four different control schemes to suit all playstyles!
These are the different modes to pick from: face buttons and shoulder buttons on gamepad, WASD on keyboard, and a quadrant selection on both.
After some testing, we think these are the best ways to let you manually control the limbs, but of course we'd love to hear what you think about it.
This update is also introducing Korean localization, welcome Korean players!
